product.name: Clutch Alignment Tool / Installer for Refitting Replacement Clutches
product.description: Suitable for virtually all vehicles under 5 tons with a single plate clutch.  Easy alignment and installation on the work bench or in situ. Gives perfect alignment of clutches, you can assemble them on the bench then take it to the car. Fits over 90% of all cars and light vans, old or new. Not suitable for vehicles with double plate clutches. Kit comes complete with three different sized expanding collets. Simple to use; 1. Place clutch plate over pressure plate on workbench, insert tool through centre and push down. 2. Tighten the small wheel to expand the collet which is inside the clutch plate. 3. Tighten the funnel wheel until contact is made with the pressure plate then turn both plates over. 4. Align both plates together by sliding them sideways until both edges are parallel, then firmly tighten the funnel shaft, holding both plates together.

product.name: Stainless Steel Shower Panel with LED Temperature Display Thermostatic Mixer Shower Set
product.description:
Introducing our high-quality Shower Panel Thermostatic Mixer Shower Set, crafted with superior materials to provide you with an indulgent showering experience. Made from a combination of durable brass and 201 stainless steel, this shower panel is built to last and withstand daily use.
Designed for convenience and easy installation, this shower panel is wall-mounted, allowing you to save space in your bathroom while adding a sleek and modern touch. Its compact design makes it suitable for any bathroom size or style.
Experience the ultimate relaxation with the Rainfall+Water blade feature. The large overhead rainfall shower provides a gentle and soothing downpour, creating a spa-like sensation in the comfort of your own home. The water blade feature adds an extra touch of luxury, offering a unique and invigorating waterfall effect.
Not only does this shower panel offer exceptional relaxation, but it also provides adjustable water jets to cater to your specific needs. Whether you desire a gentle mist or a powerful massage, the adjustable jets allow you to customize the water pressure and direction, enhancing your shower experience.
Safety is a top priority, which is why this shower panel includes a thermostatic mixer valve. This valve ensures that the water temperature remains constant throughout your shower, preventing sudden temperature changes and reducing the risk of scalding.
In addition to its functionality, this shower panel boasts an elegant design that complements any bathroom decor. The combination of brass and 201 stainless steel gives it a timeless appeal, while the sleek finish adds a contemporary touch.

product.name: Shower Panel Tower, LED Mixer System with Twin Rain Shower Heads and Body Jets
product.description: Upgrade your bathroom with this Rozin stainless steel shower panel system, featuring 5 shower functions for a relaxing spa-style experience at home. Designed for wall-mounted installation, it includes easy-clean nozzles, LED lighting, and manual hot and cold water control for everyday comfort and performance.

product.name: Shower Panel System Stainless Steel Curved
product.description: This multifunctional shower panel system has a stylish design and will make a great addition to your bathroom. The shower tower is made of durable stainless steel with a brushed finish and has a beautiful, curved design. It has four functions: rainfall, waterfall, massage jets and a handheld showerhead, which can be easily selected by means of a knob. The LED lights can be switched on or off depending on your mood. The water temperature is adjustable with the thermostat knob. Immerse yourself in a truly relaxing shower experience and enjoy the modern style of this beautifully designed shower panel system! Note: Gas water heaters and solar water heaters are not suitable for thermostatic faucet use. Tap water which contains powdery sediment, solid lumps or soft objects may reduce the sensitivity of the thermostatic valve core and shorten the service life of the thermostatic faucet.

product.name: Aluminum rain shower system with handheld showerhead and soap dish - grey
product.description: Enjoy the feeling of pleasant summer rain with this shower panel from tectake. This complete set features high-quality workmanship. All surfaces feature clean lines and a shining chrome look. Assembly is simple and easy thanks to the standard connections. Take a break and relax under this comforting shower panel from tectake.

product.name: 6 in 1 Brushed Nickel Shower Panel with Rainfall Jets Handheld and LED Display
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with this sleek and modern Rain Shower System, designed for both style and performance. Featuring a brushed nickel finish and dual-function control, this wall-mounted system offers a premium showering experience with both elegance and ease of use.

Powered by hydroelectric energy with an operating voltage of ≤36V, it functions efficiently without the need for batteries, making it both eco-friendly and low-maintenance. The minimalist design and high-quality materials ensure durability and long-lasting performance, perfect for any contemporary bathroom.

product.name: Balterley Hopwas Round 1 Tap Hole Ceramic Basin with Semi Pedestal 520mm White Bathroom Sink (Tap Not Included)
product.description: The Balterley Mila Round 1 Tap Hole Ceramic Basin with Semi Pedestal (520mm) combines a soft rounded shape with modern functionality. Its smooth contours and minimalist pedestal design bring a sense of balance and elegance to any bathroom space. Crafted from durable fireclay with a crisp white finish, it delivers strength, lasting shine, and effortless style.

product.name: Pumpkin Shaped Boucle Decorative Draught Excluder - Rust/White
product.description: Add warmth, charm, and functionality to your home with the OHS Boucle Pumpkin-Shaped Draught Excluder. Measuring 20 x 90cm, this decorative wind stopper is expertly designed to block cold air, reduce noise, and improve energy efficiency by sealing gaps at the bottom of your doors. Crafted from ultra-soft boucle fabric in a cosy rust and white colour palette, the unique pumpkin-shaped design brings an autumnal, rustic touch to your hallway, living room, or bedroom. Not just a stylish accent, this weighted draught stopper stays securely in place while being easy to move and store. Perfect for seasonal or year-round use, it’s a practical and decorative solution for keeping your space warm and inviting.

product.name: AquaECO Submersible Pond Pump 4500 L/H
product.description:
The new AquaECO series of pond pumps from All Pond Solutions with its brand new innovative electronics brings massive energy savings, low noise, and long durability while maintaining high performance.Compared to other pond pump brands the wattage use of the AquaECO range of pond pumps is extremely economical, saving you money in the long run.

Ultra Low Wattage:
* AquaECO-4500 (4500L/H) = 30w

Designed to circulate water to a pond filter or waterfall, the AquaECO cage is specially designed to tolerate particles of dirt/ debris up to 6-8mm and prevent clogging by providing the maximum surface area for drawing water in through the guard to the pump.

Included with the AquaECO pump is an additional inlet that allows you to attach a hose to the inlet of the pump to provide water directly from a source such as a pond skimmer.Operational mode 1:

Designed to be placed straight into your pond, the AquaECO will simply draw water directly in through the filter cage, through the pump, and out of the directional hosetail outlet.Operational mode 2:

By attaching the included hosetail inlet to the front of the pump, you can direct an alternative water source (such as a pond skimmer) directly into the front of the pump.The inlet and outlet hosetail adaptors' direction can be adjusted by slightly unscrewing the blue hosetail nut, adjusting the angle to your requirements, and then re-tightening the hosetail nut.The filter cage is secured using four strong clips which allow for easy tool-free access to your pump and impeller area.The cage design incorporates a convenient handle meaning the AquaECO pump can be removed from your pond easily, avoiding potential damage by pulling the power cable to retrieve the pump.

Specifications
Flow rate: 4500L/h
Height Max: 400cm
Max Height Flow Rates: See Product Images
Cable Length:10M
Wattage: 30w
Voltage: 220-240V
Inlet / Outlet hosetail connector: 25/32/38mm

Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner and outer layer and reinforced with 3 or 4 plies of polyester braid, these couplers deliver exceptional strength, flexibility, and reliability. Available in internal diameters from 6 mm up to 152 mm and lengths from 50 mm to 950 mm, they cover everything from compact engine bays to large industrial installations. Each hose is precision-moulded to ensure a secure fit and optimal flow. Built to SAEJ20 industry standards and compatible with most fluids, these couplers are trusted by professionals for motorsport, marine, automotive, and manufacturing use. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: Aveli Low Profile 800 x 800mm Square Shower Tray with Brushed Brass Waste
product.description:
The Hydrolux Low Profile 800 x 800mm Square Shower Tray is designed for modern bathrooms requiring practical installation with a stylish white finish. Measuring 800mm by 800mm and standing only 45mm high, this tray provides easy step-in access, making it suitable for both new bathrooms and refurbishments. This shower tray is compatible with most standard square shower enclosures from a range of brands and can be further adapted for hard floors using an easy plumb riser kit, available separately. Installation is straightforward, and the included waste components feature a standard 40mm connection and offset elbow for convenience. The tray is not non-slip surfaced, so consideration may be needed for additional matting if used by the elderly or mobility-impaired. A 10-year warranty offers long-term peace of mind.

When a plug hole is blocked and the water won't drain, Crikey Mikey Sink Bomb is a fast-acting formula that helps dissolve blockages in kitchen, bathroom and shower plug holes without needing a plumber. It removes the nasty smells blockages cause and kills the germs breeding within them.

product.name: Garland Budget Propagator with Drainage Holes - Small, 23cm Seed Tray for Windowsills
product.description:
Get your seeds off to a strong start with the Garland Small Budget Propagator, a practical and affordable solution for home seed germination. Designed to create a warm and sheltered environment, this compact propagator helps encourage faster germination and healthier early growth for flowers, herbs, vegetables and other young plants.

The sturdy injection-moulded base tray is made from 100% recycled plastic and features two-tier drainage holes that support effective base watering while helping to prevent waterlogging. Maintaining the correct moisture level is essential for successful germination, and the drainage system helps protect delicate seedlings from excess water during their early stages of growth.

A lightweight clear vacuum-formed lid helps retain warmth and humidity around your seeds, creating a consistent environment that encourages quicker germination and stronger development. The transparent cover also allows plenty of natural light to reach your seedlings while making it easy to monitor progress without disturbing the growing conditions.

Manufactured in the UK, this compact propagator is ideal for windowsills, conservatories, greenhouses and other small growing spaces. Measuring 23cm long, 17cm wide and 12.5cm high, it is perfectly sized for raising a variety of seedlings while taking up minimal space.

Whether you are starting a vegetable garden, growing herbs indoors or raising bedding plants for the season ahead, the Garland Small Budget Propagator offers a simple, reliable and environmentally conscious way to achieve better germination results.

Rainwater Butt Diverter Set for waterbutts
Diverters are additional fittings that can be attached to your home downpipe to provide a direct connection to your water butt.

Designed to collect some rainwater diverting the rainwater into your waterbutt. The diverter connector kit uses a tube straight into your water butt with the ability to control any overflow when your water butt is full.

Waterbutt Connector Fixing Kit: Allows easy collection of rainwater from your downpipe. Prevents the water butt from over filling when it is full. Connects downpipe to the rain barrel.

Perfect for your garden or allotment allowing water to be easily accessed when needed.

This waterbutt hose kit set includes; 1x rain diverter, 1x hose connector, 1x flexible hose pipe, 1x washer and 1x fixing nut.

Divert rain from your downpipe to your rain barrel fits the majority of downpipes used in the home, including square and round types. Once the water butt is full (if properly fitted) the water butt will not overflow but the water will continue to flow down the downpipe.

FEATURES
Downpipe Rainwater Diversion Kit.
Suitable for both round and square downpipes
Made of sturdy black plastic
Easy to install
Great water saver
Made in the UK

Using a rainwater diverter is a great way to save on costs and time on refilling, reduce your impact on the environment and maintain a supply of free and readily available water for use around the home and garden.

product.name: ARKO BATHROOM Universal White Soft Close Toilet Seat ,Top Fix, Quick Release, Round , Made in Turkey
product.description:
Product information
Looking to upgrade your toilet seat with something that’s built to last and simple to maintain? The Arko Bathroom universal soft-close seat combines modern comfort with easy everyday use. Sourced from Turkey and made from durable ABS plastic, it features a clean white finish that suits both modern and traditional UK bathrooms.
Designed to fit most standard round toilets, this seat offers a quick-release function for hassle-free cleaning and a top-fix installation that makes fitting it from above simple—even in smaller spaces. The soft-close lid adds a quiet, smooth touch to your daily routine while helping protect little fingers from accidental slams.Dimensions
    • Hinge adjustment range: 66mm to 166mm
    • Shape: Round
    • Installation type: Top fix

Good to know
To keep your seat looking new, clean with a soft cloth and mild soap. Avoid bleach or abrasive products to protect the finish and keep hinges working smoothly.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Q: Will this seat fit my toilet?
A: This seat is designed to fit most round UK toilets with hinge holes 66–166mm apart. Just measure the distance between your fixing holes to confirm.
Q: How easy is it to install?
A: Very easy! The top-fix system lets you install it from above the pan. Everything you need—including fittings and instructions—is included in the box.
Q: Can I remove the seat for cleaning?
A: Yes. With the quick-release button, the seat comes off in seconds—making deep cleaning around the pan quick and hassle-free.
Q: Is the soft-close feature reliable?
A: Absolutely. The lid and seat gently lower without slamming, giving you a quieter, safer experience that’s especially helpful in busy households.
Q: What material is the seat made from?
A: It’s crafted from premium ABS plastic—lightweight yet strong, easy to wipe down, and resistant to cracks, chips, and daily use.

product.name: Plumbright 15mm Compression Magnetic Scale Reducer PBM/15/CPS
product.description: Plumbright Magnetic Scale Reducers (MSR) can be used in both domestic and commercial properties. Magnetic Scale Reducers are recommended as single appliance protection installation. The MSR can be fitted vertically or horizontally and there is no preferred direction of flow. It includes simple compression fittings for easy connection to standard pipe. The MSR consists of a copper body with a permanent magnet inside. Magnetic Scale Reducers are installed to help prevent the build-up of limescale formation (mainly made from calcium carbonate) in appliances. By preventing limescale formation, the damaging potential reduction in operational life of the appliances and the costly drop in efficiency can both be reduced or minimised. An MSR creates a magnetic field which changes the crystal structure of calcium carbonate making it less likely to cluster as limescale on heat exchangers, elements and pipework.

product.name: 30mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Black Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

Whether you need full pressure on one side and a trickle on the other, the adjustable valves allow for customized water flow to meet specific requirements. This functionality ensures that you can efficiently manage your water usage, minimize waste and maximize the effectiveness of your watering or cleaning tasks.
Constructed from strong, durable plastic, the Double Tap Connector is built to withstand the rigors of outdoor use. Its robust design ensures longevity, even in challenging weather conditions. The contrasting black and orange colour scheme not only provides a sleek, modern appearance but also makes the connector easy to spot and operate in various environments.

product.name: Water Butt Extension Kit 3/4 Inch BSP Tap Hose Barb Connector 27mm Hole Saw Drill Bit Tank Fitting Set
product.description:
This 3/4" BSP water butt extension kit provides a complete solution for installing or upgrading taps on water butts, tanks, and containers. Designed for convenience and reliability, the set includes all essential components needed to create a secure outlet connection and improve access for filling or hose attachment.

The brass-threaded extension features both male and female 3/4" BSP threads and extends approximately 50mm, making it easier to connect hoses or access water flow from containers. It can be installed into existing threaded openings or fitted into a newly drilled hole. The included securing nut and sealing washers ensure a tight, leak-resistant connection while evenly distributing pressure to reduce the risk of deformation.

The white PVC tap with 3/4" BSP male thread and hose barb allows easy control of water flow and provides a secure connection for standard hoses. Lightweight yet durable, it is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use with good resistance to corrosion and weather conditions.

A 27mm HSS hole saw drill bit is included, allowing clean and precise cutting in plastic, wood, and metal, making installation quick and straightforward even for DIY users.

Kit includes:

1 x 3/4" BSP water butt extension (male and female thread, approx. 50mm)
1 x securing nut
2 x sealing washers
1 x white PVC tap with hose barb (3/4" BSP male)
1 x 27mm HSS hole saw drill bit

Note: PTFE tape not included.

product.name: PP Cross 1 BSPF is a Highly Versatile Pipe Fitting Designed
product.description:
The PP Cross 1" BSPF Connector is a highly versatile pipe fitting designed to alter the direction of piping systems in 4 directions at 90 degree angles. Featuring BSP female threads, this connector ensures a secure and reliable connection to other threaded components in the system. It is ideal for applications where there is a need to navigate around obstacles, reconfigure piping layouts due to spatial limitations, and branch out in four directions, making it an essential component in various fluid transport systems.

Constructed from robust polypropylene (PP), this cross connector offers excellent durability and resistance to corrosion and harsh environmental conditions. The high-quality plastic material ensures a long service life, even in demanding applications, making it suitable for both industrial and domestic use. 

This cross connector is not only easy to install but also provides a tight, leak-proof seal, reducing the risk of fluid leakage and ensuring efficient flow management within the piping system. Its lightweight design simplifies handling and installation, while the precision-engineered threads guarantee compatibility with standard BSP fittings that have a matching thread size.

product.name: Copper Brake Pipe Repair Kit Flaring Tool Bender M10 DIN suitable for Ford Focus 1998-2004
product.description:
This professional kit includes everything you need to repair and replace old corroded brake pipes. 
Suitable for 1998-2004 Ford Focus (M10 Unions with DIN Flare). 
British made flaring tool with precision machined punch and die blocks produces an OEM specification DIN pipe flare the same as the original. 
Flaring tool can be used on the car in-situ allowing pipes to be joined on the car and be replaced in smaller sections. 
High quality pipe bender designed specifically for brake pipes makes it easy to form neat and accurate bends in the brake pipe.
Correctly sized 3/16" (4.75mm) pipe bender ensures a consistent internal diameter right across the bend compared to oversized pipe benders designed for plumbing. 
Suitable for vehicles with M10 x 1mm brake fittings using the DIN flare. Will not produce SAE Single or Double Flares. (See photo for flare types) 
Kit Includes; 
● Professional hand held flaring tool. 
● A 25ft (7.6m) roll of 3/16" (4.75mm) Copper Brake Line (Conforms to BS EN 12449, 3120 PSI Max Working Pressure) 
● 10 x Male Brake Pipe Fitting Unions M10 x 1mm. 
● 2 x Female Inline Pipe Joiners M10 x 1mm. 
● Professional brake pipe bender, correctly sized for brake pipes. 
● Mini brake pipe tubing cutter.
Includes everything required to professionally repair and replace old brake pipes. 
Note; Brake lines are a safety critical component and should only be repaired or made by competent persons with sufficient knowledge and experience to complete the work to a safe standard. Always double check the new fitting and pipe flare is identical to the original.
